blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Vegetable farmers and gardeners from the Cordillera brought their concerns over rising production costs, low farmgate prices and agricultural imports to national government agencies during a two-day mobilization in Metro Manila that began on Tuesday, Nov. 10. Organized by the activist Kanatengan Network, the delegation is scheduled to submit petitions and seek dialogues with members of the House of Representatives and officials of the Department of Agriculture (DA), the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), and the National Commission on Indigenous Peoples (NCIP).
